title: Ezra's Prayer After the Mixed Marriages
description: Ezra reacts with deep sorrow when he learns that the people, leaders, and priests have married into foreign nations. He tears his clothes, pulls hair from his head and beard, and sits in despair until the evening sacrifice. Then he falls on his knees, stretches out his hands to the Lord, and offers a humble prayer in which he confesses the people's guilt and praises God's grace for allowing a remnant to survive.
